description: Rabi-splitting comparison: NEP with the molecular polarizability term included vs neglected, against the explicit CBOA QEDFT reference (octopus, data/octopus_CO2_CBOA_FD.txt). One cavity mode resonant with the CO2 asymmetric stretch; coupling eps_tilde = lambda*omega. The lambda grid is taken from the reference file (first row). For each lambda the lower/upper polariton frequencies are extracted from the dipole_x spectrum and cached in data/nep_chi_{included,neglected}.txt (regenerate with generate_nep.py).
